newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki says has FIM 1.5 bln war chest.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki says has FIM 1.5 bln war chest.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy CEO Timo Peltola said on Friday its deal with Hershey Foods of the United States would give it 1.5 billion markka to develop the company.
After the asset swap and brand-licensing deal with Hershey, Huhtamaki will have "about 1.5 billion markka to develop the company," Peltola told a news conference.
"Company acquisitions are not excluded as a possibility," he said in response to a question. @
"The programme (to develop Huhtamaki) will certainly include company acquisitions, too," he added.
"We intend to build an even stronger position in our current business sectors," Peltola said.
He declined to comment on the size of Huhtamaki's annual royalties from Hershey's U.S. sales of Leaf confectionery, but said this revenue would be "significant". @
Summing up the overall impact of the deal for Huhtamaki, Peltola said: "We will get new resources to develop the company in Europe and in Asia."
He earlier said it would have a "significant positive impact" on Huhtamaki's profitability next year. It will reduce Huhtamaki's annual net sales by about one billion markka.
